title: Spanish Tapas Platter Chicken
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make tapas platter featuring chicken and Spanish ingredients. Perfect for a quick dinner or appetizer.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic.
In a large skillet, heat the Spanish olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Meanwhile, arrange the sliced yellow bell peppers on a serving platter.
Top the peppers with the shredded cheese and chopped parsley.
Serve the chicken on top of the peppers.
Optional: add olives and artichoke hearts to the platter for added flavor.
